title: Kanban App Shell (replace stock Vite scaffold)
description: Replace the stock Vite starter (counter + doc/social links) in src/App.tsx with the kanban application shell: header, active-board region, and a horizontal columns area.
spec:
1. Remove the stock counter/doc/social-links markup from src/App.tsx
2. Render an app header showing the app name and the active board name
3. Render a horizontal, scrollable columns area beneath the header
4. Wire the shell to the store so it renders the active board from state
5. Verify no leftover references to hero/react/vite starter assets remain in the rendered UI
6. Verify the page has no console errors on load (agent-browser errors is empty)
